last.verdict: Earnings beat, but a narrower outlook and rising costs sent shares lower.

reasons.label: Outlook underwhelmed
reasons.text: New full-year profit range midpoint of $13.25 per share sat below the $13.41 analyst consensus.

reasons.label: Costs and weaker Q4
reasons.text: About $2bn of commodity inflation expected; CFO said Q4 profit will fall from Q3.

reasons.label: Cautious management tone
reasons.text: CEO Barra said the outlook has become harder, though 2027 should be stronger if demand holds.

story: GM has beaten profit estimates for several quarters and raised its outlook in April and July. Shares fell about 3-4% in April, when a one-time tariff refund flattered results. They jumped about 5% in July. October's beat was overshadowed by cost worries.
